name: MIDI Bunny: The Visual Novel!
source:
A short visual novel through the every day of Cecily Renns, the bunny girl rock star from the emo pop band MIDI Bunny!

[from [url=https://cecilyrenns.itch.io/midi-bunny-the-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的视觉小说，讲述了情绪流行乐队MIDI Bunny中的兔女郎摇滚明星塞西莉·雷恩斯 (Cecily Renns) 的日常生活！

[来自[url=https://cecilyrenns.itch.io/midi-bunny-the-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
